result.unrestricted_subsidiary_designation_flex: Effective as of the Waiver Effective Date, the definition is fixed. Unrestricted Subsidiaries are limited to the Subsidiaries of the Lead Borrower listed on Schedule 1.01D as of the Closing Date, plus any Subsidiary of an Unrestricted Subsidiary. The amended definition does not allow any other Subsidiary to be designated.

lme_vectors.rationale: The amendment closes off designating new Unrestricted Subsidiaries, but the subsidiaries on Schedule 1.01D (and any of their subsidiaries) stay unrestricted. This text does not say how much can be invested in, or what assets can be moved to, those existing entities.
lme_vectors.basis: Section 1(a) amends and restates the definition of “Unrestricted Subsidiary” to cover only Schedule 1.01D subsidiaries as of the Closing Date and their subsidiaries. No investment or IP-transfer restriction appears in the text provided.
